description: This file manages FSMonitor settings within a Git repository, including configuration, remote compatibility checks, and mode management (IPC, hook, disabled). It defines functions for setting and retrieving FSMonitor modes and reasons, and handles remote directory considerations.

classes.name: fsmonitor_settings
classes.description: Structure holding FSMonitor mode, reason, and hook path.

methods.name: check_remote
methods.description: Checks if the repository's worktree is remote and if remote FSMonitor is allowed.

methods.name: check_for_incompatible
methods.description: Determines if the repository is incompatible with FSMonitor based on remote status and OS settings.

methods.name: alloc_settings
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new fsmonitor_settings structure with default disabled mode.

methods.name: lookup_fsmonitor_settings
methods.description: Loads FSMonitor settings from repository configuration or environment.

methods.name: fsm_settings__get_mode
methods.description: Returns the current FSMonitor mode for the repository.

methods.name: fsm_settings__get_hook_path
methods.description: Returns the hook path used for FSMonitor.

methods.name: fsm_settings__set_ipc
methods.description: Sets FSMonitor mode to IPC if compatible.

methods.name: fsm_settings__set_hook
methods.description: Sets FSMonitor mode to use a hook script.

methods.name: fsm_settings__set_incompatible
methods.description: Marks FSMonitor as incompatible with a specific reason.

methods.name: fsm_settings__get_reason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for the current FSMonitor mode.

methods.name: fsm_settings__get_incompatible_msg
methods.description: Generates an explanatory message for an incompatible FSMonitor reason.
